title: 2026-11-05: Keep working on the in-memory version rather than loading from github again

sections.name: narrative
sections.content:
This may be something I hit as a developer and I want to do my editing, and test a bug fix. 
But it is handy to just keep working on the in-memory version - if it still exists, rather than loading from github again.
